lines.en: I chase the captain along the deck seams.
My foot bones knock on wet wood.
The iron hook clinks at my waist.
I can walk straight even through waves.

lines.zh: 藤壶在我脚踝上结了壳。
lines.en: Barnacles have crusted over my ankles.

lines.zh: 海风穿过我空空的肋骨。
lines.en: Sea wind blows through my hollow ribs.
I slip at every step but never stop.

lines.zh: 甲板上的盐粒被我踩碎。
lines.en: I crush the salt grains on the deck.
I follow the captain's boot prints.
I drag torn sailcloth onto the shore.
Water leaks between my finger bones.

lines.zh: 咸水从我的肋骨间漏下来。
lines.en: Salt water drips out between my ribs.
My shin bone hit a wooden barrel.
The tide pushes me; I push back.
I run after the shine of the captain's sword.

lines.zh: 绳索在栏边晃，我从下面过去。
lines.en: A rope swings at the rail; I pass beneath it.
I stand and wait for the captain's order.

lines.zh: 我数着自己剩下的时间。
lines.en: I count the little time I have left.
Seagulls cry above my head.

lines.zh: 我听见船底漏水的声音。
lines.en: I hear water leaking in the hull.
My jawbone has not closed tight.

lines.zh: 盐在我关节里结成硬块。
lines.en: Salt hardens inside my joints.
I lean against a broken mast.

lines.zh: 我只是一副会走的骨头。
lines.en: I am only bones that learned to walk.
The damp makes my bones soft.
I listen to the work songs far off.
My empty chest carries an echo.
I wait to be called back to the deck.

lines.zh: 我忘了自己叫什么名字。
lines.en: I have forgotten what my name was.
Rainwater has pooled in my eye sockets.
You are not one of the captain's men.
You smell like fresh water.
Those boots are not a sailor's.

lines.zh: 你也在数我们的时间吗。
lines.en: Are you counting our time too?
You stand too near the railing.
I look at you like driftwood.
Keep your hand off that rope.
Your eyes have no sea in them.
I remember how the living breathe.
Our captain would like you.

lines.zh: 船长叫我来的，三十秒就走。
lines.en: The captain called — I leave in thirty seconds.

lines.zh: 这一下打歪了我的头骨。
lines.en: That blow set my skull askew.
My arm clatters onto the deck.
The bone split, but I keep moving.
I hear myself rattling.
You scattered my knuckles.

lines.zh: 疼痛只是震动，不是感觉。
lines.en: Pain here is only vibration, not feeling.
I brace on the mast and stand.
That knocked out my teeth.
I do not fear pain; I have no flesh.
Gold coins flash in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 有酒味，我的骨头都醒了。
lines.en: I smell rum; even my bones wake up.

lines.zh: 那块骨头比我自己的结实。
lines.en: That bone is sturdier than mine.

lines.zh: 你手里的铜钱响得真好听。
lines.en: The copper in your hand rings sweetly.
I like a freshly ground blade.
The smell of salt pork stops me.
That hat is missing an owner.

lines.zh: 你袋里装着火药和铜钱。
lines.en: Your bag holds gunpowder and copper coins.

lines.zh: 我用效劳换你一枚硬币。
lines.en: I will serve you for one coin.
Drop the gold on the deck.

lines.zh: 我半边胸骨被撞得塌了。
lines.en: Half my ribcage caved in from the hit.

lines.zh: 我的骨头磕在你护甲上。
lines.en: My bones clack against your armor.
I sway badly but do not fall.

lines.zh: 这一撞让我肩膀错位了。
lines.en: That hit knocked my shoulder out of place.
You stepped on my foot bones.

lines.zh: 我伸手扶墙，手穿了过去。
lines.en: I reach for the wall and my hand passes through.
Two skeletons clatter against each other.
Do not crowd; the deck is only so wide.
I hear my collarbone rattle.
I give half a step, no more.

lines.zh: 我只是一具短命的骨头。
lines.en: I am only short-lived bone.

lines.zh: 谁会想娶一副走狗骨架。
lines.en: Who would marry a lackey's frame?

lines.zh: 船长的命令比婚约重要。
lines.en: The captain's orders outrank any vow.
I will not even see tomorrow.

lines.zh: 我的时间不够爱一个人。
lines.en: I have too little time to love anyone.

lines.zh: 要是有另一具骷髅陪我数浪。
lines.en: If only another skeleton counted waves with me.

lines.zh: 我的骨头太潮，抱不住谁。
lines.en: My bones are too damp to hold anyone.

lines.zh: 三十秒的性命谈什么长久。
lines.en: What lasting bond fits in thirty seconds?
The sea will remember this moment for me.

lines.zh: 我只想有人在旁边站着。
lines.en: I only want someone standing nearby.

lines.zh: 我捡起一枚湿透的铜币。
lines.en: I pick up a soaked copper coin.
This plank splinter is still useful.
I wrap the cut rope around my wrist.
I keep the empty bottle to hold wind.

lines.zh: 我拾起船长丢下的帽子。
lines.en: I pick up the hat the captain dropped.
I gather the bones one by one.
This nail is mine now.
I stuff the wet cloth between my ribs.

lines.zh: 沉船的东西都算我们的。
lines.en: Wreck goods belong to us by right.
I pick up a piece of green copper.
The captain pointed your way.
Someone is breathing at the bow.
I hear a plank creak underfoot.
The splashing is wrong; someone boarded.
Footsteps there, and not even ones.
I smell a living person.
The captain signals and I rise.
A shadow waits behind the mast.
I hear a scabbard knock.
Someone has touched our cargo.
I wait for you to face away from the rail.

lines.zh: 船长的矛一挥，我就数你的气。
lines.en: The captain waves his spear; I count your breaths.
I slip to the far side of the ropes.
My time is short; do not run.
The captain will come from the left.
I will take your ankle first.
One step back puts you at the edge.
I hear your heartbeat quicken.
Do not rest your hand on that hilt.
The deck complains beneath you.
My finger bones rake across your face.
This fist has no flesh, only bone.
I bite down with black teeth.
You block me and bone splits.
I tear open your collar.
Pain means nothing to bare bone.
I drive my skull into your chest.
My hook catches your belt.
You strike back and I do not yield.
This blow is for the captain.

lines.zh: 船长一步，我就从海里起来。
lines.en: One step from the captain and I rise from the sea.
I am hauled from the waves onto the deck.

lines.zh: 盐水和铁锈一起落在我身上。
lines.en: Salt water and rust fall over me together.

lines.zh: 我睁眼就看见船长的背影。
lines.en: I open my eyes to the captain's back.

lines.zh: 我是这具身体最后一点东西。
lines.en: I am all that is left of this body.

lines.zh: 海底的沙还挂在我肋骨上。
lines.en: Seabed sand still clings to my ribs.

lines.zh: 我站起来了，时间开始走。
lines.en: I stand, and my time starts running.
The voice that called me was coarse.
One more skeleton under the torn sail.

lines.zh: 我从水线以下的暗处上来。
lines.en: I come up from the dark below the waterline.

lines.zh: 火会把我剩下的骨头烧白。
lines.en: Fire will bleach my remaining bones.
My spine came apart on landing.

lines.zh: 我沉下去，再不会被召回。
lines.en: I sink, never to be recalled again.
The blast threw me back into the sea.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过了我的肋骨。
lines.en: An arrow passed between my ribs.

lines.zh: 魔法让我的骨头开始脱落。
lines.en: Magic makes my bones come loose.
I do not eat; I only fall apart.
The lightning pinned me to the deck.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有海也没有船长。
lines.en: There is no sea or captain in the void.
